card.name: Eras and periods of history
card.fires_on: Words in phrases about historical or geological periods, such as 'in each period', 'in every age', 'every generation', 'over time' and 'past eras'. It marks the point where the sentence speaks of what happens across eras.

modes.label: Each/every period
modes.description: The word 'period', 'each' or 'age' in phrases that say something holds in every era.
modes.example: we find that in each<< period>> a given theory is entertained by science as

modes.label: Verb after past-era subject
modes.description: The verb that follows a subject about past eras or generations.
modes.example: evidence from past geological eras that sudden releases of methane<< have>> triggered runaway cycles of climate

modes.label: Change over time
modes.description: Words about change across time, in history or climate.
modes.example: Baker shows how racial categories change over<< time>>.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about periods and history, such as 'periodic' and the Chinese words for 'history' and 'past years'.
card.plain: It lights up when the text talks about what happens in every era or across history.
